name: pages
about: Create a page, give it a title, add a to-do line. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it

gaps: This scenario verifies page title and body text through the native block fields of the single guest document editor; it does not verify checkbox toggling, undo, search, or row context actions.

steps.say: open the Pages tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Pages tab is selected and the pages view shows a New page button; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading
a new page opens: the toolbar title label reads Untitled and the page list has an Untitled row; no error

steps.say: type the title into the Heading 1 field
steps.expect: the toolbar title label reads QA walk {param:walk_tag} and the page list has a row named QA walk {param:walk_tag}

steps.say: type a to-do item into the empty Text field below the Heading 1 title
steps.expect: the page body contains tape the walk, and the save status label reads Saving… or Saved (not Not saved); no error
